item.title: New tabletop game store to open in Walker’s Point
item.description: Tabletop Bookshelf, an analog gaming retailer previously operating out of a basement, will open its first brick-and-mortar storefront in Milwaukee’s Walker’s Point neighborhood on March 21. item.title: Weyco Group hopes to recover $16 million via tariff refunds
item.description: Weyco Group paid $16 million in tariffs in 2025, a cost the business hopes to recover through a lawsuit it filed to request a tariff refund.

item.title: Waukesha-based Kinex Medical Company settles $6.9 million whistleblower lawsuit
item.description: Kinex Medical will pay $6.9 million to settle allegations it billed Medicare, TRICARE and other programs for unnecessary medical braces.
